decision: Phase D implementation is complete; exit is blocked pending live-provider and installed-client certification.

checks.requirement: Authorization defaults to deny and rejects expired or explicit denials.
checks.note: Deterministic policy tests cover scope, fields, expiry, and deny precedence.

checks.requirement: Media bytes and ranges are available only after an API policy decision.
checks.note: The object-store boundary exposes opaque keys, not direct object URLs.

checks.requirement: Search cannot disclose result metadata or snippets before PBAC filtering.
checks.note: External search remains a non-authoritative candidate projection.

checks.requirement: Export submission, job visibility, and download are separate PBAC gates.
checks.note: Storage paths are not returned by the governed download API.

checks.requirement: Job output requires authorization independently of job submission.
checks.note: Lease recovery does not weaken output authorization.

checks.requirement: The one-node reference can be verified, restored, migrated, and composed.
checks.note: Restore is intentionally non-destructive and targets a new data root.

checks.requirement: Run repository parity and recovery against a supported live PostgreSQL service.
checks.note: No provider-backed execution record is present in this release.

checks.requirement: Run governed ranges/uploads and PBAC-filtered search against live S3 and OpenSearch.
checks.note: No provider-backed execution record is present in this release.

checks.requirement: Exercise the packaged web client over a real TLS listener and trusted browser.
checks.note: The SSL-context contract is tested; installed-client field evidence is absent.
